title: LaPaz statement in Aviation Week on two unknown objects

tellings.quote: On August 23rd, 1954, Aviation Week and Space Technology published a statement from LaPaz,

plain: On August 23, 1954, the trade magazine Aviation Week and Space Technology published a statement from a scientist named Lincoln LaPaz about two unknown objects tied to White Sands, New Mexico, which would mean unexplained objects were being tracked near Earth in the early space age. Michels brings it up himself in a conversation with the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel, alongside the final report of the Near Earth Satellite Project, an effort to search for objects circling close to Earth.
